video.prompt:
[SCENE] Late autumn night at a small Japanese farm shed. Low close shot of the shed's open doorway and damp concrete floor (doma). A pair of plain matte black knee-high rubber boots stands on the wet concrete, a little dried mud on the soles. Rain drips steadily from the corrugated tin eaves in the foreground. In the first second the scene is almost dark, then a single bare incandescent bulb hanging above flickers on and warm light spreads over the boots and the wet floor.
[CAMERA] Slow steady push-in at boot height, 35mm lens, aperture f/5.6 so the doorway and floor stay readable, focus on the boots. Real-time speed, no slow-motion, no shake.
[LIGHTING] Mostly deep darkness, then one warm 2700K bulb from above, hard pool of light, specular glints on wet rubber and puddles, cool faint blue night ambience outside the doorway.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Glossy wet black rubber, rough grey concrete with puddles, falling water droplets, weathered wooden door frame, rusty tin eaves.
[COLOR PALETTE] Near-black shadows, warm amber bulb light, cool deep blue night. High natural contrast, the upper half of the frame stays dark.
[AUDIO] Natural sounds only: rain dripping on tin and concrete, the click of a light switch, faint night insects. No music, no voice.
[AVOID] Logos, text, letters or brand marks on the boots or anywhere, people's faces, extra boots, deformed or morphing boots, product packaging, camera shake, fisheye distortion, heavy bokeh, overexposure.
